title: Insha ya wasifu (Theme 1: Mapishi)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 5 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child names the kind of writing from what it does and how it is laid out: tells events, describes, explains, or writes to someone.
representations: four model texts (wasifu, masimulizi, maelezo, barua)
steps: Ask: tells, describes, explains, or writes to someone?

board.say: Matini hii ni ya aina gani?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child sorts four texts into the chart.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Kifungu kinaelezea sura, tabia na maisha ya mtu. Ni insha ya aina gani?" Kwa nini "masimulizi" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Insha ya wasifu humwelezea mtu: sura yake, tabia yake na maisha yake. Masimulizi husimulia matukio.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Kifungu kinaeleza hatua za kupika uji. Ni insha ya aina gani?" Kwa nini "masimulizi" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Insha ya maelezo hueleza jambo au jinsi ya kufanya kitu. Masimulizi husimulia tukio lililotokea.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Kifungu kinasimulia kilichotokea Jumamosi kijijini. Ni insha ya aina gani?" Kwa nini "wasifu" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Masimulizi husimulia matukio kwa mpangilio. Wasifu humwelezea mtu mwenyewe.
Salamu na hitimisho la barua huonyesha ni barua, si insha.

checks.question: Insha inayoeleza jinsi mtu alivyo ni ya aina gani?
Barua hutofautianaje na insha?
checks.answer: ina anwani, salamu na hitimisho la barua

skills.key_step: The child plans insha ya wasifu before writing: the parts in order, then one idea at a time, then checks it against the type.

floor.prerequisite: Writes a correct sentence with a capital letter and a kikomo.
floor.question: Andika sentensi moja kuhusu shule yako.

representations: a model text with its parts labelled
steps: Read the title and say the type.
Check against the checklist and correct.
contexts: a letter or story for a family member

board.say: Insha hii ni ya aina gani, na itakuwa na sehemu zipi?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child fills the three-box plan for "Mpishi Hodari wa Kijiji Chetu".

misconceptions.repair: Insha ya wasifu hueleza jinsi kitu au mtu alivyo, si matukio ya siku moja.

misconceptions.ask: Msomaji anaona nini akisoma sentensi hii?
misconceptions.repair: Tumia vivumishi na maelezo ya rangi, umbo, ukubwa na sauti ili msomaji aone picha.

misconceptions.ask: Nomino hii iko katika ngeli gani?
misconceptions.repair: Kivumishi hupatana na nomino yake: bendera nzuri, miti mirefu, mtoto mzuri.

listen_for: Rafiki yangu ana baiskeli mpya ya rangi ya bluu.
misconceptions.ask: Sentensi hii inahusiana vipi na anwani?
misconceptions.repair: Kila sentensi ya insha inapaswa kuhusu anwani.

misconceptions.ask: Aya yako ya kwanza inafanya kazi gani?
misconceptions.repair: Insha ina utangulizi, kiini chenye aya kadhaa, na hitimisho.

checks.question: Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika insha ya wasifu kuhusu "Mpishi Hodari wa Kijiji Chetu"?
checks.answer: Mama Neema ni mfupi, mnene kiasi, na ana tabasamu pana kila wakati.

checks.question: Insha ya wasifu ina sehemu zipi?
